item.title: World Baseball Classic begins this week
item.description: No moment in baseball history had ever felt quite as scripted as Shohei Ohtani striking out Mike Trout to win the 2023 World Baseball Classic. The two biggest stars in the sport matched up with two outs in the ninth inning of a one-run game, and they happened to be major-league teammates. Perfection, even though it was a little too unrealistic for Hollywood.
